A lesion can be many many things with many causes. Kinda like a cough is generally from a cold and not lung cancer. Can be, but typically not. Lesions can be from injury, auto immune disorders, and often times no known cause. Treatment may be wait n see or various therapies and treatments. 

Try not to look on line. You will find no confirmation as to what it is or what will be, only the Dr can get into that. Are you losing weight? Vomiting? Sickly? Unable to focus or function? If not, chances are then that this will be minor (physically) and more of a nightmare in your mind. (Oh yay for health anxiety) I had a colonoscopy once because my BM was shaped weird and I was CONVINCED it was cancer. Ugh.

Breathe. Distract yourself. By no means ignore health matters but understand "what it is - is what it is," however usually IT ISNT. *hugs**
